history.event: Claude refinement: 49 line(s) suggested — I corrected garbled sheep-contract vocabulary (pechore, chapre, chastroni, agnelli, istimo, aloghai, montano), misread numbers and dates (1414, 72, 𝒹 6), and the abbreviation ꝓ, which Kraken wrote for every p: it is now ꝑ where the descender is crossed and a plain p (or ꝙ) elsewhere. | layout: l2: the initial G (Ghuasparino) is outside the box, to the left; I put it in the text.; l3: the initial F of Fabiano is outside the box, to the left; I put it in the text.; l8: the box holds only the initial E of l9 ('E piu aloghai…'); merge it with l9.; l23: a tiny box over a small mark (f/ß-like) under the sums rule to the right of l21–l22; it is probably not text.; l39: an empty box (a ruling stroke) to the right of l38.; l44: the figure 3 before 'montoni' is outside the box, to the left; I put it in the text.; l48: the initial P of 'posti' is partly outside the box.; l49 and l50 are one line split in two (ghuasparino | alibro C …); l51 and l52 are one line too (partono … | adi primo di dicenbre 1417).; l53: an empty box (a stray stroke) in the right margin.; l54 and l55 are marginal sums in the right column; the C above l54 has no box. | doubts: All lines: there are no conventions files and no rules for Princeton_MS_131, so the choice of ⫳ for the struck 'lb' lira sign, ƒ, ꝑ/ꝓ and ꝙ follows the Kraken habits and the MPAP/Baker practice; Laura should confirm the signs for this manuscript.; l1: the day number after 'adi' (xx…m?) cannot be read with certainty.; l6, l10, l41, l42, l43, l46, l38, l31: the lira sign is written as a struck 'lb'/'ln'. Kraken read it as la/tu/lo/ƒ; I used ⫳[?].; l30–l31: if the figure is lire 183 ß 3 𝒹 3, the half is ⫳ 91 ß 11 𝒹 7½, which fits the 91 in l31; then 'ßii 𝒹 3' in l31 may really be ß 11 𝒹 7 (the ʒ-shaped figure would be 7 there). Please check the figures against the image.; l54: the numerals were left untouched as instructed. The first letter may be D, not u; Dlxxxviiij ß viiij (589 lire 9 soldi) would match 307.19.6 + 6 + 275.10 from the entry.; l55: marginal sum, illegible to me; left as Kraken read it.; l13: 'avevano[?]' versus 'dovevano'; l17/l34: 'chanatone', 'chamarie' and 'essbochate' (= sboccate?) are uncertain.; l25: the first name (tiziano?) and the place (daronchotte, cf. l45 'da ronchote') are uncertain.; l36: the signs between 'pechore' and '72' (ß and a cross-like mark) are unclear.; l50–l51: 'a ff 7', 'delle dore', 'partono 13 cholui' are guesses.
